desc:
🍵 Welcome to My Matcha Shop! 🍵

Build the coziest matcha café on Roblox, from a single counter to a bustling three-story empire!

Take your customer's order, craft their drink exactly how they want it — ice, matcha, and the perfect topping, then serve it up and get paid. Every drink you make by hand earns a bonus!

☕ WHAT YOU'LL DO
🧋 Craft 15 unique matcha drinks, from Classic Latte to Golden Honey
🍡 Unlock toppings — boba, lychee jelly, popping boba, even gold flakes
👩‍🍳 Hire cashiers and baristas to run your shop for you
⭐ Upgrade your stations, storage, and staff to serve faster
🏗️ Rebuild your shop through 3 massive tiers, each one unlocks a brand new menu

🍀 KEEP AN EYE OUT
Lucky customers pay up to 5x! Hit drink milestones for huge cash bonuses, claim daily rewards, and climb the global leaderboard to prove you're the #1 matcha shop owner.

Can you build the ultimate matcha empire?

⭐ Like & Favourite to support us — more drinks and updates coming soon!
👥 Join MangoGames
